data.gender_notes: Rahish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rahish means the one who rules or reigns over others. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja' which means king or ruler. This name is often given to boys who are expected to be strong and powerful leaders. The name Rahish carries the meaning “Ruler, King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rahish usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
